Date: Thu, 8 Jul 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Thanks — quick procurement next steps from today

Hi Priyom / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — quick recap and a few asks from procurement so we can move the PO through our system: 

1) We need your vendor onboarding packet (W-9 or W-8 as applicable) and preferred banking routing for ACH or wire.
2) Please confirm whether Redwood is willing to invoice via our vendor portal (preferred) or whether we should process via credit card (we can do marketplace if you’re listed there).
3) Any standard SLA or indemnity language we should expect in the PO review? Our legal team will do a brief review but it speeds things up to know if there are non-starters.

Can you send the packet and indicate the preferred commercial path (portal PO vs card vs marketplace)? Goal is to have a PO in week-of 7/19.

Attachments: [Attachment: vendor_onboarding_packet_request.pdf (application/pdf)]

Thanks,
Ava Morales
Sr. Procurement Manager | ScaleBridge
procurement@scalebridge.com

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 9 Jul 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Thanks — quick procurement next steps from today

Hi Ava — great to meet today, appreciate the clear list. Quick answers and next steps from our side: 

- I’m attaching our vendor packet and completed W-9 for Redwood Inference (see attachments).
- We support all three billing paths you mentioned: 1) Vendor portal PO (preferred for predictable invoicing and remittance), 2) Credit card via marketplace (we are listed on CloudMarket), and 3) Direct invoice (ACH/wire).
- Typical payment terms we accept on new enterprise deals are Net 30 by default; we can discuss Net 45 for larger committed spend.

Questions for you so we can prepare the correct paperwork:
- If you choose vendor portal PO, does ScaleBridge require us to register in a specific supplier portal (Link or Coupa/Ariba)? If yes, please share the supplier registration link and any unique tax IDs needed.
- For marketplace purchases, do you want us to send a SKU/pricing attachment (makes checkout easier)?
- Any special FOIA/compliance or data-handling addenda needed for your legal review (beyond standard DPA / SOC2 reference)?

Attaching: [Attachment: Redwood_vendor_packet_2027-07.pdf (application/pdf)], [Attachment: W-9_Redwood.pdf (application/pdf)]

I’ve looped in Dev from Finance to help with banking routing details — Dev, can you confirm our ACH remit details and whether we can provide a dedicated invoice email for ScaleBridge?

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
